megan: Need a compact front/back one-pager for launch covering deploy modes, SLAs, security callouts, and one benchmark nugget.
jamal: Should be usable as email blurb, webinar promo, and field leave-behind.
luis: Layout idea: top elevator, 3-row deploy matrix (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), security bullets, SLA snapshot, benchmark line.
anna: Field wants: KMS/HSM notes, VPC options, audit logs, and simple routing labels for inbound leads.
megan: Benchmark suggestion: "P95 latency 120-220ms at 95% utilization on typical chat workloads (dedicated pools)." Add legal: internal lab results; results vary.
jamal: Include 2-line seller scripts: Platform: "Which constraints matter most—isolation, throughput, or residency?" Security: "We integrate with customer KMS/HSM and provide audit trails."
luis: Inbound routing snippet for ops: deploy_interest:hosted|dedicated|private, compliance_need:high|medium|low, sla:standard|enterprise. Simple tags to enterprise-sales or growth.
megan: Owners: copy=jamal, benchmarks=luis, field validation=anna, design=design-team. Target final by Thu.
deploy-bot: design request #DB-412 queued (ETA 48hrs).
